frequency_question: What proportion of major unilateral executive tariff or sanction enactments are successfully executed and enforced within an 80-day window from initial announcement?
membership_rule: Includes any executive branch-led imposition of sweeping tariffs or trade restrictions under statutory emergency or trade authorities; excludes standard multi-year negotiated trade treaty implementations.

cases.name: Liberation Day Tariffs / Reciprocal Trade Actions (Hypothetical Rapid Orders)

coverage_note: 5 major actions named; representative of executive speed under statutory authority.
known_gaps: Borderline cases where preliminary announcements underwent sudden pauses are difficult to cleanly categorize without violating the blind-to-news rule.
skeleton: Executive actions executed under emergency or expedited statutory powers where customs systems require electronic tariff schedule updates.
multiplier: 5 instances analyzed across historical trade action rollouts; 3 completed operational implementation within 79 days.
validity_reason: Based on statutory processes for customs rule promulgation, which remain stable across administrations barring legislative reform of Section 232 or 301.
